United States Department of the Interior
OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY WASHINGTON, D.C. 202.0
4734
MAY 2 6 1971
Dear Mr. Orletcke:
This is in response to your letter of April 9, transmitting the draft environmental statement prepared by the Department of Housing and Urban Development for Operation Breakthrough. We have reviewed the statement and other materials available on the project and offer the following comments for your consideration.
Operation Breakthrough as described in the environmental statement should narrow the existing gap between housing technology and application of such mechnological advances throughout the housing industry. Faced with a backlog of about one million units, future housing requirements will demand new record outputs. The stated goals and objectives of Operation Breakthrough are admirable and should improve both the social and physical environment of residential areas by applying both a systems perspective and new technology.
The draft environmental statement, although providing an encellent description of the program and concepts involved, lacks sufficient detail relative to the issues set out in Section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. A number of the points which need clarification and/or elaboration to make the environmental statement a complete, self-contained document are developed below.
General considerations—The complex nature of Operation Breakthrough, which involves 22 housing types at 11 widely distributed sites, makes the preparation of one statement covering the entire program extremely difficult. The various environmental concerns associated with each site and housing type are lost in the context of the total program. It would be desirable to include basic information and comparison of the activities planned at each location.
Such information might include: number of housing units, estimated number of residents, cost range of units, acreage of open space and recreation areas, community services and facilities planned, discussion of adjacent land uses, site plans and a discussion of maintenance requirements for each type of housing unit. If additional activities are planned for the Operation Breakthrough program, consideration should be given to the preparation of environmental scatements for each location.
